content:
rhea: quick sync note: we need a stable plan for attaching billing identity to observability without exploding metric cardinality. thoughts?
omar: short answer: traces carry full billing_key, metrics carry a low-cardinality bucket + reserved counters for top spenders.
toni: agree. also add deterministic sampling so we can scale sampled traces back to full traffic for chargebacks.
frank: what about short-lived tenants and spikes? collisions in buckets could hide big spikes from metric alerts. maybe reserve top-200 explicit counters and hash the rest into 256 buckets.
ops-bot: ops-bot: running preliminary sim for series growth with N=256 and topK=200, ETA 5m.
omar: add span attrs: billing.key, billing.bucket, billing.sample_rate, billing.reconciled. traces -> raw billing_key; metrics -> billing_bucket only.
rhea: ops needs an API for on-demand high-fidelity billing runs for finance (rehydrate traces for date range). frank: +1, also surface an estimated_error_pct with invoices.
toni: privacy: billing_key access gated. metrics exports to Datadog must map bucket->tag and never export raw billing_key.
frank: action items: 1) rhea to write short RFC addendum (due Fri), 2) omar to draft span+metric examples and sampling pseudo-code, 3) ops to post sim results and storage estimates.
ops-bot: ops-bot: sim results posted -> https://ops.internal/reports/bucket-sim-4012360000
rhea: ok scheduling 30m follow-up next Tue. lean +1 to hybrid (top-K + hashed buckets + sampled traces).
